subject: Request: SAML/SCIM & RBAC artifacts for SOC 2 review — evidence delivery
messages:
From: Elena Perez <elena.perez@medtech.co>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medtech.co
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SAML/SCIM & RBAC artifacts for SOC 2 review

Hi Irene,

We are kicking off the SOC 2 evidence collection for our audit window and need a compact package showing your identity and access controls for the tenant we use. Specifically we need:
- A handful of sample SAML assertions for users (with PII redacted or hashed)
- A SCIM delta snapshot showing provisioning events for the last 30 days
- A short RBAC activation log (owner/approver, timestamp, action) showing role assignments and revocations
- A short note describing how you perform redaction and any hashing/salting process used

Target delivery: 2026-07-22 (audit packet owner is Lenora on our side). If you can share temporary drive links and a short redaction readme, that would be ideal.

Are there any blockers on your side? Happy to set a quick 20-min call if needed.

Thanks,
Elena Perez
Controls Lead, MedTech Co

[Attachment: audit-request-checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Perez <elena.perez@medtech.co>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML/SCIM & RBAC artifacts for SOC 2 review

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble the package and have draft artifacts by 2026-07-20, final by 2026-07-22.

Quick clarifications:
1) For the SAML samples, do you require full AuthnContext values or just NameID + attributes?
2) For the SCIM delta, is CSV fine for you (timestamp,event_type,actor,subject)?

Looping in Jonas and Priyom from our IAM team to pull the samples and draft the redaction note.

– Irene

irene.choi@redwood.ai

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SAML/SCIM & RBAC artifacts for SOC 2 review

Internal — forwarding MedTech's ask. Please treat this as time-sensitive; Lenora's audit window wants final artifacts by 7/22. Notes:
- SAML samples must have identifiers redacted/hash consistent across samples (so MedTech can verify mapping without PII).
- SCIM delta should include prototype of the last 30 days, CSV ok but include header row and column definitions.
- RBAC activation log: pull three representative events (assign, revoke, ownership transfer) with approver IDs.

Jonas: can you generate the SCIM snapshot and the RBAC CSV?
Priyom: can you extract the SAML assertion samples and document the redaction/hashing method?

Please reply here with ETA and attach any sample files. If you hit policy-scoped data, flag me immediately.

Thanks,
Irene

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SAML/SCIM & RBAC artifacts for SOC 2 review

On it — attaching the initial artifacts for internal review. Summary:
- scim-delta-snapshot.csv (sample of provisioning events, 30-day window)
- rbac-activation-log-sample.csv (three representative events; columns: timestamp, action, actor_id, subject_id, approver_id)
- access-redaction-readme.md (describes our hashing pipeline: HMAC-SHA256 with tenant-specific salt; no plaintext PII in artifacts)

ETA for polished SAML samples: EOD tomorrow (Priyom), after which we’ll bundle for delivery.

Jonas Weber
IAM Engineering

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, security@medtech.co
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML/SCIM & RBAC artifacts for SOC 2 review — delivery

Hi Elena / Lenora,

Thanks for your patience — attached is the draft evidence bundle for your SOC 2 packet. Included:
- saml-assertion-samples.txt — 5 SAML assertion examples with NameID and attribute sets. All user identifiers are HMAC-SHA256 hashed with a tenant salt; the redaction readme explains the mapping process.
- scim-delta-snapshot.csv — 30-day provisioning delta (header row included).
- rbac-activation-log-sample.csv — three activation events showing assign/revoke/transfer with approver ids.
- access-redaction-readme.md — how we applied hashing and what was removed/kept.

Drive link (temp, expires 2026-08-03): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-9812

Notes on redaction: we do not include email addresses, full names, or employee PII. The readme documents verification steps if you need consistent mapping across artifacts. If you would like, we can run a short walkthrough next week to show how the redaction is deterministic for mapping but one-way for privacy.

If this satisfies the audit packet, please confirm and we will mark the ticket as delivered. If you need any additional context (AuthnContext values or full saml logs under an NDA), let me know and we can route through legal.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

[Attachments: saml-assertion-samples.txt (TXT), scim-delta-snapshot.csv (CSV), rbac-activation-log-sample.csv (CSV), access-redaction-readme.md (MD)]
